$doc: Blessed flow witnesses — generated by check-flows.mjs, committed on purpose. Reviewing this file IS the blessing: each flow's resolved chain is frozen here, one step per line, and a resolution that drifts from it fails the gate until someone re-blesses with `node check-flows.mjs --rebless`. Never hand-edit; regenerate.

flows.name: publish-a-post
flows.description: The bottom nav's New post opens the wizard on every tab root; pictures are cropped, described, and signed into the feed.
steps: start · «nav · New post» on 26 boards → ComposePick
ComposePick · 3 «Next» → ComposeCrop — pictures — the crop
ComposeCrop · 3 «Next» → ComposeDetails — pictures — details next
ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeSeal
end · ComposeSeal · 7 «Sign and publish» → ComposeLanded — signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-avatar-standalone
flows.description: The change badge on your own profile picture goes straight to the crop and its own seal — one signature, the picture alone.
steps: start · Profile · 4 «avatar change badge» → AvatarCrop — the system picker, then the crop — the standalone shortcut
AvatarCrop · 3 «Next» → AvatarSeal — the standalone change off the profile badge — its own seal
end · AvatarSeal · 4 «Sign the change» → back — signed — shown everywhere you appear

flows.name: edit-avatar-via-edit-screen
flows.description: Changing the picture from the edit screen returns to it — one seal covers the picture and the fields together.
steps: start · Profile · 6 «Edit profile» → ProfileEdit
ProfileEdit · 2 «Change picture» → AvatarCrop — the system picker, then the crop — Next returns here; one seal covers everything
AvatarCrop · 3 «Next» → ProfileEdit — come from the edit screen — the edit's one seal signs it
ProfileEdit · 6 «Save» → ProfileEditSeal
end · ProfileEditSeal · 4 «Sign the change» → back — signed — the profile updates

flows.name: narrow-the-feed
flows.description: The band's filter trigger opens the filter sheet; the sheet applies live, and tapping out leaves the reader on the narrowed feed.
steps: start · Feed · 1 «Posts (filter chip)» → FeedSheet
end · FeedSheet · 6 «scrim — tap outside» → FeedNarrowed — narrowed

flows.name: sign-in
flows.description: Email and password on the sign-in screen land a member with their key on this device in their own feed.
steps: start · SignIn
end · SignIn · 6 «Sign in» → Feed — member, key on this device

flows.name: reply-to-a-post
flows.description: The comment count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the thread sheet; Add a comment opens the composer, and the seal signs the reply back into the thread.
steps: start · «comment count» on 19 boards → ReplyEntry
ReplyEntry · 7 «Add a comment» → ReplyCompose — the full-focus composer, parent pinned
ReplyCompose · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: open-a-topic
flows.description: A topic chip on a post opens that topic's page — the page itself is still owed.
steps: start · Feed
end · Feed · 6 «topic chip» → gap: the topic page (ruled 2026-09-01 — not designed)

flows.name: sign-in-with-the-key-elsewhere
flows.description: The same sign-in on a device the key is not on — reading runs, and anything signed waits until the key is restored.
steps: start · SignIn
end · SignIn · 6 «Sign in» → KeyElsewhere — member, key not here

flows.name: join-with-an-invite
flows.description: An invite link checks out at the door, then handle, email and password make the account and the applicant days begin.
steps: start · InviteEntry
InviteEntry · 3 «Continue» → Join — the link checks out
end · Join · 6 «Create account» → ApplicantFeed — account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: guest-turns-applicant
flows.description: Sign in or join, offered on every guest screen, runs out to the invite and through Create account into the applicant days.
steps: start · «Sign in or join» on 4 boards → SignIn
SignIn · 8 «New here? Enter your invite» → InviteEntry
InviteEntry · 3 «Continue» → Join — the link checks out
end · Join · 6 «Create account» → ApplicantFeed — account created — applicant days begin

flows.name: verify-the-email
flows.description: Back to CoGra in the verification mail returns an applicant to the feed their application still runs in.
steps: start · Verified
end · Verified · 1 «Back to CoGra» → ApplicantFeed — application still running

flows.name: verify-the-email-as-a-member
flows.description: The same mail opened once the application has been approved lands a full member in their own feed.
steps: start · Verified
end · Verified · 1 «Back to CoGra» → Feed — already a member

flows.name: make-your-key
flows.description: Create my key runs the ceremony — the recovery code shown, written down, confirmed — and hands the applicant back where it began.
steps: start · ApplicantFeed · 3 «Create my key» → KeyCeremony
KeyCeremony · 2 «Create my recovery code» → KeyConfirm
KeyConfirm · 2 «Show my code» → RecoveryCode
end · RecoveryCode · 3 «I've written it down» → back — code confirmed — returns where the ceremony began

flows.name: vouch-back-for-your-inviter
flows.description: Vouch back on the approval landing opens the stance pad; the signed stance ends the borrowed view and the member's own feed opens.
steps: start · VouchBack · 3 «Vouch back» → VouchBackPad
end · VouchBackPad · 4 «Set» → Feed — the vouch-back — signed, the way opens

flows.name: restore-your-key
flows.description: Restore the key, wherever the key-absent screens offer it, takes the recovery code and returns to whatever was waiting on it.
steps: start · «Restore the key» on 4 boards → Restore
end · Restore · 4 «Restore the key» → back — key restored — returns where restore began

flows.name: publish-your-payout-address
flows.description: The wallet's first open makes the key and signs the payout address onto the record — the wallet then stands at zero, address published.
steps: start · WalletSetup
WalletSetup · 2 «Create and publish» → WalletAddressSeal
end · WalletAddressSeal · 5 «Sign and publish» → WalletEmpty — published — the zero wallet, address on record

flows.name: change-your-payout-address
flows.description: Change on the wallet takes a new address to its own seal; the signed change puts it on record, newest wins.
steps: start · WalletEmpty · 3 «Change» → WalletChange — then the seal
end · WalletChange · 5 «Sign the change» → Wallet — signed — the new address on record, newest wins

flows.name: trace-a-payout-to-what-paid-it
flows.description: A settling payout row opens the settlement that paid it — the settlement's own view is still owed.
flows.blockedBy: the paying settlement's view (not boarded — every line opens what paid it)
steps: start · Wallet
end · Wallet · 5 «payout · settling row» → gap: the paying settlement's view (not boarded — every line opens what paid it)

flows.name: see-a-campaigns-money
flows.description: The wallet's Campaigns door lists what you run and what you took part in; a row opens that campaign's money view.
steps: start · Wallet · 4 «Campaigns door» → WalletCampaigns
end · WalletCampaigns · 5 «open campaign row» → WalletCampaign

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-post
flows.description: Press and hold the stance face, wherever a post is drawn, and the pad blooms; the signed stance lands back where it was taken.
steps: start · «stance face» — to VouchBackPad on 14 boards → VouchBackPad
end · VouchBackPad · 4 «Set» → back — signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: close-the-filter-unchanged
flows.description: The filter sheet opened and shut with nothing touched leaves the feed exactly as it was.
steps: start · Feed · 1 «Posts (filter chip)» → FeedSheet
end · FeedSheet · 6 «scrim — tap outside» → Feed — unchanged

flows.name: filter-the-feed-to-nothing
flows.description: Every kind switched off leaves a feed with nothing left to show — the empty state carrying its own way back.
steps: start · Feed · 1 «Posts (filter chip)» → FeedSheet
end · FeedSheet · 6 «scrim — tap outside» → FeedNothing — everything off

flows.name: filter-the-feed-far-from-the-default
flows.description: A filter pushed far enough from the default that the trigger counts the changes instead of naming them.
steps: start · Feed · 1 «Posts (filter chip)» → FeedSheet
end · FeedSheet · 6 «scrim — tap outside» → FeedFar — far from the default

flows.name: undo-the-narrowing
flows.description: A feed filtered until nothing shows offers Show posts again — the one control that puts the default back.
steps: start · FeedNothing
end · FeedNothing · 2 «Show posts again» → Feed — the default restored

flows.name: search-into-a-thread
flows.description: Typing in Explore brings results as they are typed; a comment result opens the thread that comment sits in.
steps: start · Explore · 1 «search field» → ExploreSearch — typing — results as you type
end · ExploreSearch · 6 «comment result row» → ReplyEntry — the comment in its thread

flows.name: narrow-a-search
flows.description: The results' Everything trigger opens the search filter; the sheet applies live, and tapping out leaves the reader on the narrowed results.
steps: start · ExploreSearch · 2 «Everything (filter trigger)» → ExploreFilter
end · ExploreFilter · 5 «scrim — tap outside» → ExploreSearch — the sheet closes

flows.name: reply-to-a-comment
flows.description: Reply on a comment opens the same composer pre-targeted at it — one commenting mechanism over many targets, each target declaring its own start and end.
steps: start · ReplyEntry · 5 «Reply» → ReplyCompose — the composer, pre-targeted at that comment
ReplyCompose · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: reply-with-pictures
flows.description: Pictures added to a reply land in its tray; one seal signs the words and the pictures together into the thread.
steps: start · ReplyEntry · 7 «Add a comment» → ReplyCompose — the full-focus composer, parent pinned
ReplyCompose · 5 «+ Add pictures or a video» → ReplyPictures — picks land in the tray
ReplyPictures · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: reply-with-a-video
flows.description: A video picked for a reply puts the composer in its video state, where its face is chosen and its one description written; the same seal signs the words and the clip together into the thread.
steps: start · ReplyEntry · 7 «Add a comment» → ReplyCompose — the full-focus composer, parent pinned
ReplyCompose · 5 «+ Add pictures or a video» → ReplyVideo — a video — the composer's video state
ReplyVideo · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: reply-while-the-pictures-upload
flows.description: Next pressed while the pictures are still going up reaches the gated seal; signing waits for them, then the comment settles into the thread.
steps: start · ReplyPictures · 3 «Next» → ComposeSealUploading — uploads still running — the gated seal (master on the media page)
end · ComposeSealUploading · 7 «Sign and publish (disabled)» → ReplyEntry — uploads land — signing proceeds to the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: edit-your-comment
flows.description: Edit on your own comment opens the edit surface; the signed edit settles back into the thread it belongs to.
steps: start · ReplyMedia · 6 «Edit (own comment)» → CommentEdit
end · CommentEdit · 12 «Sign the edit» → ReplyMedia — signed — the thread, the edit settling

flows.name: publish-words
flows.description: Write words instead takes the wizard's other half — no crop, no cover, the same details and the same seal signing words alone into the feed.
steps: start · «nav · New post» on 26 boards → ComposePick
ComposePick · 4 «Write words instead» → ComposeWords
ComposeWords · 3 «Next» → ComposeDetails — the words path skips crop and cover
ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeSeal
end · ComposeSeal · 7 «Sign and publish» → ComposeLanded — signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: publish-a-video
flows.description: A video takes a step of its own — the cover picks the face the post wears, and details and seal follow the way pictures do.
steps: start · «nav · New post» on 26 boards → ComposePick
ComposePick · 3 «Next» → ComposeCover — a video — its face
ComposeCover · 6 «Next» → ComposeDetails
ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeSeal
end · ComposeSeal · 7 «Sign and publish» → ComposeLanded — signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: cite-something
flows.description: + Cite something, wherever a composer offers it, opens the picker over everything citable; a result row lands the citation in the composer's references.
steps: start · «+ Cite something» on 6 boards → ReferencePicker
end · ReferencePicker · 5 «result rows» → back — the pick lands in the composer's references

flows.name: set-your-own-stance-on-your-post
flows.description: Adjust on the seal blooms the one-axis pad — your own post always reaches you in full, so the stance is declared before signing, never assumed.
steps: start · ComposeSeal · 5 «Adjust (your stance)» → ComposePad
end · ComposePad · 4 «Set» → ComposeSeal — the adjusted stance on the seal

flows.name: pick-a-kept-draft-back-up
flows.description: New post with a draft kept asks before it opens; Continue resumes that draft at details, and the same seal signs it into the feed.
steps: start · ComposeExpired · 15 «nav · New post» → ComposeDraft — a draft is kept — the prompt first
ComposeDraft · 4 «Continue» → ComposeDetails — resumes where it left — this draft at details
ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeSeal
end · ComposeSeal · 7 «Sign and publish» → ComposeLanded — signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: edit-your-post
flows.description: The own-post overflow offers Edit; the edit surface carries its changes as signed acts of their own and the post settles with them.
steps: start · ComposeLanded · 2 «post overflow ⋮» → RemoveMenu — the own-post sheet
RemoveMenu · 1 «Edit» → EditCompose
end · EditCompose · 12 «Sign the edit» → back — signed — the post, the edit settling

flows.name: remove-your-post
flows.description: Remove asks once, then leaves the mark — the post is redacted where it stood, never silently erased.
steps: start · ComposeLanded · 2 «post overflow ⋮» → RemoveMenu — the own-post sheet
RemoveMenu · 3 «Remove» → RemoveConfirm
end · RemoveConfirm · 1 «Remove» → Removed — the visible mark — never silent

flows.name: set-the-cover-and-order
flows.description: Show all opens the picked batch as a list; dragging sets the order, the first picture is the cover, and Done returns wherever the sheet opened.
steps: start · ComposePick · 5 «Show all» → ComposePicked — the Show-all sheet (drawn on the media page)
end · ComposePicked · 4 «Done» → back — the sheet closes — pick, details, or edit, wherever it opened

flows.name: describe-your-pictures
flows.description: Describe the pictures, wherever pictures are staged, opens the sheet; what is written there is witnessed at signing and never gates the upload.
steps: start · «Describe the pictures» on 6 boards → ComposeDescribe
end · ComposeDescribe · 3 «Done» → back — the sheet closes

flows.name: publish-while-the-uploads-run
flows.description: Details written while the pictures are still climbing reach the gated seal; signing waits for them, then the post lands in its detail view, still settling.
steps: start · ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeUploading — uploads still running — details keep writing (drawn on the media page)
ComposeUploading · 11 «Next» → ComposeSealUploading — uploads still running — the gated seal
end · ComposeSealUploading · 7 «Sign and publish (disabled)» → ComposeLanded — uploads land — signing proceeds to the detail view, still settling

flows.name: see-who-stands-with-someone
flows.description: The figures row, on any profile, opens the stance lists; reading who stands with them is the whole journey.
steps: start · «the figures row» on 5 boards → ProfileStances
end · arrival at ProfileStances

flows.name: find-the-thread-a-comment-answers
flows.description: A chronicle's Comments tab draws each comment with what it answers; the target pointer opens that post, its thread already open.
steps: start · ProfileOther · 6 «chronicle tabs» → ProfileComments — Comments — the cards (master)
end · ProfileComments · 17 «the target pointer» → ReplyEntry — what the comment answers — the post, its thread open

flows.name: edit-your-profile
flows.description: Edit profile opens the fields — name, bio, website — and one seal signs them; the picture has flows of its own.
steps: start · Profile · 6 «Edit profile» → ProfileEdit
ProfileEdit · 6 «Save» → ProfileEditSeal
end · ProfileEditSeal · 4 «Sign the change» → back — signed — the profile updates

flows.name: take-a-stance-on-a-person
flows.description: Press and hold the stance anchor on a profile and the same pad blooms; the stance concludes where it was taken.
steps: start · «the stance anchor» on 3 boards → VouchBackPad
end · VouchBackPad · 4 «Set» → back — signed — the stance lands, back where the pad bloomed

flows.name: message-someone
flows.description: Message on someone's profile opens the conversation with them — the chat surface is still owed.
steps: start · ProfileOther
end · ProfileOther · 5 «Message» → gap: the chat surface (not designed)

flows.name: publish-from-the-browser
flows.description: A browser draws its own pick step — files dropped on the page, no device tray — and the wizard rejoins at the crop, ending on the same seal as the native one.
steps: start · ComposePickWeb
ComposePickWeb · 3 «Next» → ComposeCrop — pictures — the crop
ComposeCrop · 3 «Next» → ComposeDetails — pictures — details next
ComposeDetails · 10 «Next» → ComposeSeal
end · ComposeSeal · 7 «Sign and publish» → ComposeLanded — signed — the detail view, still settling

flows.name: reply-from-the-browser
flows.description: In a browser the reply's pictures are dropped anywhere on the page; the tray, the words and the seal are the native ones, and one signature lands the comment in its thread.
steps: start · ReplyPicturesWeb
ReplyPicturesWeb · 3 «Next» → ReplySeal
end · ReplySeal · 9 «Sign comment» → ReplyEntry — signed — the thread, the comment settling

flows.name: visit-an-author
flows.description: The author chip, wherever a post is drawn, opens that person's profile; their chronicle is what the reader came for.
steps: start · «author chip» on 18 boards → ProfileOther
end · arrival at ProfileOther

flows.name: open-a-posts-pictures
flows.description: Post media, wherever a post is drawn, opens the post itself — a reader scrolling is choosing between posts, and the post is where the frames are whole.
steps: start · «post media» — pictures — the post opens on 12 boards → PostDetail
end · arrival at PostDetail

flows.name: watch-the-stream
flows.description: A portrait clip's tap, wherever a post is drawn, opens the stream — the reader's own ranked feed narrowed to clips taller than they are wide, swiped onward from there.
steps: start · «post media» — a portrait clip — the stream opens on 12 boards → Reel
end · arrival at Reel

flows.name: reel-to-detail
flows.description: The score element on the stream's rail is the detail door: the clip squishes to the top of the screen, still playing, and the post rises beneath it — tapping the pinned clip expands it back into the stream, the reader's place held.
steps: start · Reel · 7 «Post Score» → PostDetailVideo — the detail door — the clip squishes to the top, the post rises beneath
end · arrival at PostDetailVideo

flows.name: open-the-viewer
flows.description: Media tapped again from the post's own view opens the fullscreen viewer — the frame whole, which is what every crop in the product is measured against.
steps: start · PostDetail · 4 «detail media» → ViewerPicture — the frame, whole and full-screen
end · arrival at ViewerPicture

flows.name: follow-a-citation
flows.description: The reference count, wherever a post is drawn, opens the topics-and-references sheet; a reference row opens what was cited — that node's own surface is still owed.
flows.blockedBy: the referenced node's own surface (profile / post detail / item / campaign / chat — not designed)
steps: start · «reference count» on 11 boards → RefsSheet
end · RefsSheet · 2 «reference rows» → gap: the referenced node's own surface (profile / post detail / item / campaign / chat — not designed)

flows.name: search-and-open-a-post
flows.description: Typing in Explore brings results as they are typed; a post result opens that post's own detail view.
steps: start · Explore · 1 «search field» → ExploreSearch — typing — results as you type
end · ExploreSearch · 4 «post result rows» → PostDetail

flows.name: add-a-topic
flows.description: Add a topic on the details step opens the picker over every topic a post can carry — the picker itself is still owed.
steps: start · ComposeDetails
end · ComposeDetails · 7 «Add a topic» → gap: the topic picker (not boarded)

flows.name: cite-a-post
flows.description: The reader's overflow — on a post or on a comment, the same two rows — opens the post wizard fresh, the thing cited riding along unseen. The journey ends at the details stage, where the reference is finally on screen.
steps: start · «Cite in a new post» on 2 boards → ComposePick
ComposePick · 4 «Write words instead» → ComposeWords
ComposeWords · 3 «Next» → ComposeCited — a reference rides along — details arrives with it staged
end · arrival at ComposeCited

flows.name: mention-someone
flows.description: Mention in a new post on another's profile stages exactly what citing stages — a Reference edge. The word records only that the far end is a person, and the wizard it opens is the same one.
steps: start · «Mention in a new post» on 1 board → ComposePick
ComposePick · 4 «Write words instead» → ComposeWords
ComposeWords · 3 «Next» → ComposeCited — a reference rides along — details arrives with it staged
end · arrival at ComposeCited
